evidence: Touches the fuzzing test harness in `src/test/fuzz/fuzz.cpp` and adds a custom mutator utility in `src/test/fuzz/util/psbt.cpp`.
rationale: Adds structure-aware mutation to reach deeper PSBT deserialization code paths that byte-level fuzzing cannot effectively exercise. The PR description notes that 'Byte-level mutations rarely produce well-formed key-value maps with valid keydata... so most inputs are rejected early and the deeper per-field parsing is rarely reached.' While it provides valuable fuzzing coverage and adds general custom mutator support to `FuzzTargetOptions`, it targets PSBT parsing rather than consensus or P2P attack surfaces and is reasonably deferrable.
